notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding five mana of any color(s).
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

uses.name: Gemstone Array
uses.cardState: with a charge counter on it
